description: This file defines the LLMNode_SeqAgents class implementing an interface for a sequential agent node in a flow-based AI system. It includes methods for initialization, creating agents, and handling conversation and state updates, integrating with LangChain and custom utilities.

classes.name: LLMNode_SeqAgents
classes.description: Implements a node for sequential language model agents, managing prompts, conversation history, state updates, and agent invocation within a flow.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the LLMNode_SeqAgents with default properties such as label, name, version, description, inputs, and outputs.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes the node, setting up the agent with prompts, models, and state, and returning a configured node object.
